meta.title: Level 2 and 3 attainment age 16 to 25 (by age 19) by local authority
meta.geography: LA (of school at age 15), region, England; Bedfordshire recomputed from summed num/den
meta.quality: Official statistics from matched NPD/ILR/awarding-body records for the cohort in state schools at academic age 15, followed to age 19 (census, no sampling error).
meta.limitations: Geography = LA of the school attended at age 15 (not current residence). Excludes young people not in English state schools at 15. Level 2 = 5 GCSEs 9-4 or equivalent; Level 3 = 2 A levels or equivalent. 2020 and 2021 GCSE/A level grades were centre/teacher assessed, inflating attainment for cohorts aged 19 in 2021/22-2022/23. Counts rounded; small cells suppressed (null). FSM = eligible for free school meals at age 15; disadvantaged = FSM in last 6 years or looked after. Gap rows are DfE's published percentage-point gaps (not recomputed for the Bedfordshire total).
